note: Facts here were looked up on the verified_at date. Anything past stale_after_days must be re-checked online before it is relied on. status=unverified means it was NOT confirmed in a primary or reputable source and must be checked before use.

google.name: Google Ads
google.current_version: v25 line (v25.0 Jul 2026, v25.1 Aug 2026, v25.2 Sep 2026); v26 projected Oct 2026
google.cadence: Monthly releases since Jan 2026; 4 majors/yr; each major supported ~1 year
google.read_only_access: Official Google Ads MCP server (googleads/google-ads-mcp) is read-only; GAQL search + account listing

youtube.name: YouTube (via Google Ads)
youtube.api: Google Ads API (Video, Demand Gen campaigns)

meta.name: Meta (Facebook/Instagram)
meta.cadence: Marketing API versions retire on a shorter clock than Graph API versions with the same number

deadlines.what: Several v26.0 deprecations extend to all supported versions

known_changes: v26: Instagram Explore feed placement removed for new campaign setup
Aug 2026: some reporting breakdowns switched off for accounts that did not opt in (verify which before relying on breakdown data)
meta.read_only_access: Official Meta Ads MCP (hosted, mcp.facebook.com/ads) is READ-WRITE — treat every non-read tool as gated
meta.caveat: Version dates partly from secondary sources; confirm on the official changelog before quoting to a client.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn Ads
linkedin.api: LinkedIn Marketing API (versioned, Linkedin-Version: YYYYMM header required; latest is not applied by default)
linkedin.current_version: 202608 was latest seen in Aug 2026; monthly releases, each supported >= 1 year
linkedin.caveat: A newer monthly version (202609/202610) may exist; check recent-changes.

microsoft.name: Microsoft Advertising
microsoft.api: Bing Ads API v13 (SOAP -> REST transition)
microsoft.current_version: v13; from 2026-10-01 new features ship only via REST

amazon.name: Amazon Ads
amazon.read_only_access: Official Amazon Ads MCP Server in open beta since 2026-02-02 for API partners; it CAN create/update/delete — treat writes as gated

reddit.name: Reddit Ads
reddit.current_version: v3; Reporting API v2 retired 2025-08-30; accounts moved to Business Manager

snapchat.name: Snapchat Ads
snapchat.api: Snap Marketing API (OAuth 2.0; scopes snapchat-marketing-api, snapchat-offline-conversions-api)

apple.name: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads)
apple.api: Apple Ads Platform API 1.0 (released Aug 2026, covers App Store + Apple Maps); Campaign Management API v5 legacy
known_changes: Lifetime budgets deprecated in CM API v5; use dailyBudgetAmount

x.name: X Ads
x.api: X Ads API (version in URL path, e.g. /12/accounts)
x.current_version: 12 is the latest listed on docs.x.com versioning page (released 2022-10-27); confirm
